summary: Busy through road with no kerbside parking and houses 4-12 m away.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked at kerb
No Stopping signs at peak times

drivers.seclusion: Houses 4 m, 10 m, 11 m and 12 m from the kerb along the whole stretch.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb-to-fence verge beside a two-lane road; no pull-off and no parked cars along the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Sir Fred Schonell Drive is a busy through route near the university.
drivers.convention: No parked cars seen along this kerb; No Stopping 7-9:30am and 4-6:30pm Mon-Fri.

sun_shade: Large tree shades the west end; the rest is open to sun.
